title: The Luxury V Suite! Steps to Broadway!
description:
Stay in the center of it all. This modern, walkable apartment puts you steps from Nashville’s top spots.  Whether you are here for work, family vacation, or leisure, the suite is thoughtfully designed with comfort, style, and convenience in mind. 

We are:

0.2 miles -Music City Center
0.4 miles -Bridgestone Arena
0.4 miles -Country Music Hall of Fame
0.7 miles -Broadway
1.3 miles -Nissan Stadium
6.8 miles -Nashville Airport

Paid parking available- $30 per night

The space
Unit comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests. 

Bedroom - queen size bed and Smart TV.
Living room - queen size bed, Smart TV, Day bed/Couch that sleeps two
There are two queen-size beds and a daybed with a trundle. 

The unit is also equipped with kitchen essentials for your convenience.

Please feel free to log in to your favorite streaming app.

The balcony has a pool view.

The unit is also equipped with a washer and dryer.

Enjoy the properties' amenities such as a heated pool, gym, community courtyard, lounge and work areas.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire unit and all of the property's amenities during their stay.

This property is operated by Latch Keyless Smart Lock system. All doors in this building is operated by Latch.
Guests will receive access to Latch before their arrival.

Other things to note
Please note, in the event any of the amenities are not available during your stay, we are not responsible as this is due to property management.
This will not be grounds for a refund.
